messages.subject: Stepwise Selection in INLA
parts:
Dear INLA expert,

I have something to discuss, is there any function to do stepwise selection in INLA?
I found article that there is function INLAstep (Perform stepwise variable selection with INLA) in INLAutils package could do that.
But I Checked on CRAN there is no more.

Is there any alternative package?

Thankyou

messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Stepwise Selection in INLA
parts:
I'm not aware of any. the R-INLA package does not have any tools for
this. you get the marginal likelihood, for each fit, which can be used
for this.

messages.subject: Re: Stepwise Selection in INLA
parts:
The INLAstep function still works. You can install the INLAutils package from 
GitHub (https://github.com/timcdlucas/INLAutils) with:

library(devtools) 
install_github('timcdlucas/INLAutils')
